pretreatments.description: Use of mechanical mixers to enhance substrate dispersion and microbial activity.
Application of pneumatic mixers to optimize substrate mixing and reduce settling.
Implementation of chemical pretreatments including sodium hydroxide (NaOH) to neutralize acidic components.
Application of hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) to break down organic matter and inhibit inhibitory compounds.
Utilization of co-digestion strategies combining organic substrates to improve overall biogas yield.
Adjustment of substrate ratios, such as increasing cow manure and municipal waste proportions, to enhance microbial diversity.
